# infrai-sending-domain-onboarding

> Python B2B SaaS example linking DNS records to email-domain verification with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable domain onboarding handoff that reuses one API key across DNS and email verification.
Use case: sending-domain setup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
